fields.title: OCR company record / error record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Company fields are OCR's own basic registration record verbatim -- OCR's public search only exposes this summary information (no director/shareholder detail page is publicly reachable, unlike some other registries in this collection).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-camis-search-company-details on success, absent on an error record.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- not_found (search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network issue after retries).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

companyNameEnglish.title: Company name (English)
companyNameEnglish.description: Registered company name, English rendering, as held by OCR.

companyNameNepali.title: Company name (Nepali)
companyNameNepali.description: Registered company name in Nepali (Devanagari script), as held by OCR.

companyRegistrationNumberNp.title: Registration number (Nepali numerals)
companyRegistrationNumberNp.description: The same registration number rendered in Devanagari numerals.

registrationDateBSEn.title: Registration date (Bikram Sambat)
registrationDateBSEn.description: Registration date in the Bikram Sambat calendar used by the Nepali government, Arabic-numeral format (YYYY-MM-DD BS, not Gregorian -- passed through unconverted).

registrationDateBSNp.title: Registration date (BS, Nepali numerals)
registrationDateBSNp.description: The same Bikram Sambat registration date rendered in Devanagari numerals.

companyType.title: Company type (structured)
companyType.description: Object with key (internal enum), valueEnglish, valueNepali, and baseValue (e.g. PRIVATE, PUBLIC) as classified by OCR.

companyTypeEn.title: Company type (English, short)
companyTypeEn.description: Short English label for the company's ownership/type classification.

companyTypeNp.title: Company type (Nepali, short)
companyTypeNp.description: Short Nepali label for the company's ownership/type classification.

companyAddressEn.title: Registered address (English)
companyAddressEn.description: Registered office address (municipality/ward, district), English rendering.

isRokka.title: Under legal hold (Rokka)
isRokka.description: Whether the company is currently under a "Rokka" order -- a legal freeze/injunction recorded by OCR (e.g. due to litigation or a dispute), as shown on the public register.
